title: Building PixelSanitizer: A Privacy-First Android App for Photo Metadata Removal

title: Building a Flexible Android Design System with Jetpack Compose
excerpt: How I designed and built a flexible Compose design system library providing reusable UI components, centralized design tokens, dynamic theming, and accessibility support.
